notes: Another decisive win for the new corpora. CalibForge is essentially a bank of siblings of this exact TB2.1 task: 'find/construct a probability distribution with exact KL-divergence / entropy / mutual-information constraints (with tolerance), over a large vocabulary, saved as .npy' — including one titled almost identically and several over token distributions. All are strongly verified, so final_top10 is 8/10 CalibForge and would honestly be more. The v1 pool has nothing this close: TMax has abundant KL-divergence and distribution-fitting tasks but they mostly COMPUTE divergence or FIT a model to data rather than SOLVE for a distribution hitting exact targets, so its best (task_006780, nonlinear solving over a distribution) is a 4. Terminal-Lego contributes the enabling primitives — softmax, scipy.optimize curve-fitting, Shannon entropy — all strongly verified but each only a piece of the task (overall 3). SWE-Rebench's scipy.optimize/pyomo/softmax fixes and SWE-Smith's weight-distribution/chardet fixes are domain-adjacent at best (overall 1-2) and are filler. Recursive-Task-Synthesis has no real match: its 'scipy' hits are conda-install chores and its entropy hits are text-stats pipelines, all absent-verifier and low transfer — the merge step should treat that whole block as weak. No FREE candidate is in final_top10.
